pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("The Boot button is the button on the right, located on GPIO7... available for use in Arduino as PIN_BUTTON"). Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled, matching the identical GPIO7 BOOT button already independently confirmed via Zephyr devicetree on this board's adafruit_feather_scorpio and adafruit_feather_can siblings (same Feather RP2040 module design). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin).

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("the D13 LED... controllable in CircuitPython code using board.LED, and in Arduino as PIN_LED") and CircuitPython's pins.c (LED -> GPIO13); active-high polarity independently confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_rp2040.dts leds node (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>) for the same D13-LED module design shared across this Adafruit Feather RP2040 product line (matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio/adafruit_feather_can precedents' identical GPIO13 LED). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability — fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias from pins_arduino.h (Adafruit's own pinouts guide confirms GPIO8/14/15 are merely the general-purpose exposed Feather header SPI pins, and the EPD connector uses its own separate dedicated SPI1 bus with SS=GPIO19, not this default SS assignment), matching the identical adafruit_feather_scorpio/adafruit_feather_can bus-alias-contamination fix pattern.

pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes:
EPD_BUSY — dedicated Busy-Detect control line wired to this board's 24-pin e-Ink display FPC connector, read by e-Ink display driver libraries during refresh/init. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("EPD_BUSY/GPIO16 - The Busy Detect pin for e-Ink displays") and pins_arduino.h's PIN_EPD_BUSY alias.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: D20 (GPIO20)
pins.notes: NEOPIXEL_POWER — onboard NeoPixel power-enable gate, must be driven HIGH for the status NeoPixel (GPIO21) to be powered. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("there is a NeoPixel power pin on GPIO20. It needs to be set High for the NeoPixel to be powered") and CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (CIRCUITPY_STATUS_LED_POWER -> GPIO20), matching this repo's adafruit_feather_can NEOPIXEL_POWER exclusion precedent (same Feather RP2040 module design).

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("the status NeoPixel LED. It is connected to GPIO21") and CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (MICROPY_HW_NEOPIXEL -> pin_GPIO21). Requires NEOPIXEL_POWER (GPIO20) driven HIGH to actually light — see that pin's note.

pins.name: GPIO23
pins.label: GPIO23
pins.notes:
EPD_MOSI — dedicated SPI MOSI line for this board's e-Ink display connector (this board's PIN_SPI1_MOSI, __SPI1_DEVICE spi0). Not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("EPD_MOSI/GPIO23 - The SPI MOSI pin for e-Ink displays") and pins_arduino.h's PIN_EPD_MOSI / PIN_SPI1_MOSI aliases. This board's SPI1 has no MISO line pinned out (PIN_SPI1_MISO left at 31u/not-pinned-out), consistent with an e-Ink display being write-only over SPI.
